message.content: {"caption":"Two step-line charts compare coding-agent scores across 80 iterations on SWE-bench and Polyglot, showing the full DGM rising above the ablated systems and reference baselines.","description":"A pair of step-line charts, each with Iterations on the x-axis (0–80) and Score of Best Agent on the y-axis. The left chart is SWE-bench; the right chart is Polyglot. No individual values are printed, so the values below are approximate readings from the plotted lines. On SWE-bench, the dashed red Checked Open-sourced SoTA reference is horizontal at about 0.51. The orange DGM w/o Open-ended exploration line stays near 0.20 until about iteration 37, then rises to about 0.23 and stays level. The green DGM w/o Self-improve line starts near 0.20, rises to about 0.28 around iteration 2, then to about 0.39 around iteration 24, remaining level thereafter. The blue DGM line starts near 0.20, rises to about 0.25 around iteration 2, then about 0.41 around iteration 24, about 0.43 around iteration 47, and about 0.50 around iteration 63. On Polyglot, the dashed purple Representative Agent Baseline (Aider) is horizontal near 0.165. The orange DGM w/o Open-ended exploration line is near 0.14 through about iteration 50, then rises to about 0.18. The green DGM w/o Self-improve line starts near 0.14, steps up to about 0.16, 0.18, and 0.24 in the early iterations, then to about 0.26 around iteration 20, and about 0.28 near iteration 76. The blue DGM line starts near 0.14, rises sharply to about 0.28 and then 0.34 around iterations 14–15, reaches about 0.36 around iteration 34, and about 0.375 around iteration 64. Thus, the full DGM finishes highest on both charts; on SWE-bench it ends just below the SoTA reference.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"SWE-bench — Checked Open-sourced
